code:
SELECT grantee_name, role, granted_by, created_on
FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.GRANTS_TO_USERS
WHERE deleted_on IS NULL
ORDER BY created_on DESC;
caption: GRANTS_TO_USERS is a point-in-time view of current role assignments — not a history of grant events.

steps.label: INFORMATION_SCHEMA
steps.sub: near-real-time, scoped to one database, shorter retention

steps.label: ACCOUNT_USAGE
steps.sub: account-wide, up to 1 year of history, some latency

steps.label: SOFT-DELETED OBJECTS
steps.sub: only ACCOUNT_USAGE still shows dropped tables/views

code:
SELECT table_name, table_schema, deleted
FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES
WHERE deleted IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY deleted DESC;
caption: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES never shows a dropped table. ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES does — a real auditing advantage.

subtitle: Turning these views into a repeatable audit, not a one-off query.
